item.title: FALKIRK v CELTIC: 5-MINUTE QUIZ
item.description: CELTIC are aiming to complete a hat-trick of wins over Falkirk when the teams meet in the Premiership this evening. The Hoops knocked out the newly-promoted team from the Premier Sports League Cup with a 4-1 success in August and followed that up with a 4-0 league victory in late October, both encounters at Parkhead. item.title: IHEANACHO TARGET
item.description: KELECHI IHEANACHO is hoping Rugby Park on Sunday will provide the venue for a second dream come true. The Nigerian international striker made his Celtic debut on the Ayrshire ground on September 14 following his beat-the-UEFA-deadline signing after being freed by Sevilla. item.title: CONFIRMED: HATATE OUT, NYGREN IN
item.description: REO HATATE has dropped out of the Celtic team to face John McGlynn’s side at the Falkirk Stadium this evening. The Japanese midfielder makes way for Benjamin Nygren as the only change from Martin O’Neill’s selection that started the 4-0 win over Dundee United at Parkhead at the weekend. item.title: TARGET FRANKO AS O’NEILL STEPS UP STRIKER SEARCH
item.description: CELTIC’S one-goal victory over Falkirk merely emphasised Martin O’Neill’s urgent requirement of firepower in his frontline. A header from Benjamin Nygren – his twelfth strike of the season – from an Arne Engels left-wing corner-kick just before half-time got the job done to keep the champions six points behind leaders Hearts. item.title: CORNERED: ‘VERY PLEASED,’ ADMITS MATCHWINNER NYGREN
item.description: BENJAMIN NYGREN used his head as he claimed his twelfth goal of the season and Celtic’s matchwinner at the Falkirk Stadium. The Swede struck just before the interval in a goalmouth melee after Arne Engels had swung in an inviting corner-kick from the left. item.title: ‘A WEE BIT STRANGE,’ O’NEILL’S PUZZLER
